name: Kirigaya Hatsuka
source: The tsundere daughter of a wealthy family who has lived on the island for 7 years. She's at the age where she wants to grow up quickly, so she often pretends to be tougher than she is and acts as though she is an adult, but in her heart she wishes to meet the real Santa. Christmas is her birthday.
